2.2.1.2. Certification_LCF_Dump.config.Config.filter_types¶

property Config.filter_types¶

If True (the default), unused user types will be filtered out from Types.lcf.

Set to False when it is important that all user types are preserved, such as when a certified/approved explicit railyard is going to be used for certification instead of the compact railyard dumped by this package.
